mapper.sql: id, order_no, supplier_id, amount, status, create_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO purchase (order_no, supplier_id, amount, status) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{supplierId}, #{amount}, #{status})
INSERT INTO purchase_item (purchase_id, inventory_id, name, quantity, price) VALUES (#{purchaseId}, #{inventoryId}, #{name}, #{quantity}, #{price})
mapper.update: UPDATE purchase SET status = #{status} WHERE order_no = #{orderNo}
mapper.select: SELECT id, purchase_id, inventory_id, name, quantity, price FROM purchase_item WHERE purchase_id = #{purchaseId}
